standards_rationale.no-inline-code: Standard 1 applies only to .claude/commands/*.md and .claude/agents/*.md. scripts/lib/react_template.tpl is a JSX template file, not a command/agent .md file. Not applicable.
standards_rationale.no-hardcoded-values: The two changed lines contain no hardcoded file paths, URLs, or environment-specific values. The `accKey` string ('accommodation') is a semantically fixed slot-type identifier, not a configurable path. No new violations.
standards_rationale.use-source-venv: Standard 3 applies to .sh and .md files containing python3 invocations. Not applicable to a .tpl file.
standards_rationale.integer-step-numbering: Standard 4 applies to .md files with step numbering. Not applicable to a .tpl file.
standards_rationale.meaningful-naming: File name react_template.tpl is descriptive of its function. No forbidden patterns (enhance-*, fast-*, *-v2, etc.) present.
standards_rationale.english-only: scripts/lib/react_template.tpl is outside Standard 6's configured scan scope (agents/*.md, commands/*.md, .claude/agents/*.md, .claude/commands/*.md, hooks .sh/.py, scripts/*.sh|*.py). The two changed lines contain no Chinese text — they are pure JS condition expressions. Unconditional Standard 6 scan of .claude/agents/*.md and .claude/commands/*.md confirmed pre-existing CJK content in accommodation.md, attractions.md, cafe.md, entertainment.md, meals.md, shopping.md, rednote.md, plan.md, review.md, gaode-maps.md — all pre-existing, none introduced by this cycle's two-hunk diff.
standards_rationale.merge-similar-scripts: No new scripts created. Standard 7 not applicable.
standards_rationale.concise-documentation: Standard 8 applies to command and agent .md files. Not applicable to a .tpl file.
standards_rationale.parameterized-scripts: Standard 9 applies to shell and Python scripts. This is a React JSX template; the two changed lines use JS closures over parent-scope variables (editorSelections, editorDay), not hardcoded non-configurable values. Not applicable.
standards_rationale.dangling-references: No new script references added by the two changed lines. Standard 10 not triggered.
standards_rationale.merge-conflicts: Mandatory detect-merge-conflicts.sh was run. It reports scripts/lib/react_template.tpl (20 markers) but these are `// ====` comment section dividers, not git conflict markers (<<<<<<<, =======, >>>>>>>). Confirmed with python3 line-by-line scan: zero lines start with '<<<<<<<' or '>>>>>>>'. The two changed lines (1266-1268, 1318) introduce no conflict markers. No Standard 11 violation.
